p1: Job said that when a tree is cut down, it can sprout again. New green branches can grow!
Then Job wondered, “If a person dies, will he live again?” That was his big question.
Job wished his words could be carved in rock forever. He said, “I know that my Redeemer lives!”
p2: Job’s Redeemer is Jesus, who saves us and brings us back to Heavenly Father. Job said that one day He will stand on the earth. Job knew he would live again in his own body. Jesus died and came back to life, so everyone will live again.
Jesus lives! Because of Him, your family will live again too. Tonight, put your hand on your heart and feel His love.
old: Job had so many big feelings inside. He felt sad and confused, and he had lots of questions.
So Job talked to Heavenly Father about all of it. He didn’t hide his feelings — he shared them honestly, just like talking to a loving Father.
Even in his sadness, Job remembered something hopeful. “I know that my Redeemer lives,” he said. That means he trusted that Heavenly Father would make everything right someday.
It’s good to tell Heavenly Father exactly how we feel. He is never upset by our honest hearts. And He always gives us hope, even on our hardest days.
